$comment: Prompts for the Phase 1 camp art (#615; docs/camp.md §3.1, §4.1, §8.3 and §8.4; conventions in docs/briefs/camp.md): the open_plains camp backdrop and the stage-1 frame (a small campfire, a neutral bedroll and pack used at all four seats, the trailhead post, and the campfire's flame as a moving part). The layout these are painted for is assets/manifest.json -> camp, and every pixel figure below is derived from it on the 1920x1080 backdrop: lanes at y 562 (back), 648 (middle) and 734 (near) inside the open grass band from y 486 to 810, the camp spread across a wide clearing: the campfire at the center (x 960 on the middle lane), the four bedrolls two to each side of it (x 691 and 1229 on the back lane, 480 and 1440 on the near lane), wander spots out toward the edges (x 192 to 250 and 1632 to 1690, and on the back lane at 480 and 1440), four lane crossings (x 384, 595, 1325 and 1536), every piece and stand point inside x 154 to 1766, and the trailhead at the right edge (x 1824 on the near lane, y 734). The backdrop is drawn cover-fit and slid (packages/client/src/world/camp-framing.ts): it spans the whole width of the screen and is moved up or down so the lanes stand in the open window between the lobby's header and its panels, so its top quarter (y 0 to 270) is plain sky that may be trimmed off the top, its bottom quarter (y 810 to 1080) is plain grass that may sit under the lobby panels, and a portrait phone crops the sides, keeping about the middle 80 percent (x 192 to 1728). No heroes are painted: the existing hero figures stand on the lanes. Cutouts share the figure canvas (manifest canvas: 1024x1024, ground contact at 512,900), so they are composed the way figures are: the whole object inside the canvas with a clear margin, its lowest point at y 900. art:verify checks the formats; art:inventory lists what is still owed.

paintings.plays: The camp backdrop for the open_plains terrain family, and the fallback for every family not painted yet. Seen behind the lobby, outdoor rest scenes and the chapter's end.

paintings.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create one full-bleed landscape 16:9 game background painting for Kids & Dragons, target 1920 x 1080, fully opaque. Match the attached open plains reference exactly in palette, light and brushwork: a crafted children's storybook painting with visible brush texture, softly drawn edges and broad gouache-like color masses, friendly age-eight calm. A quiet campsite on open plains in warm late-afternoon light: a wide, flat, gently mown clearing of short green grass ringed by rolling meadow, a far line of soft blue hills on the horizon, a big friendly sky with a few slow cumulus clouds, two or three small round trees and a standing stone or two only at the far left and far right edges and in the distance. The clearing is empty: no tents, no fire, no bedrolls, no packs, no people and no creatures, because the game stands its own camp pieces and heroes on it. Composition for the game layout: the painting is shown cover-fit and slid up or down to put the camp in view, so its top and bottom may be trimmed. The top quarter of the height is plain, open sky with only soft clouds and nothing that must be seen, because it may be cut off. Keep the horizon at about 35 to 40 percent of the height. From 45 to 75 percent of the height the ground is one clear, readable, nearly level band of open grass, the camp clearing, with no rocks, bushes, paths or strong texture across it, because figures walk along three horizontal ground lines at 52, 60 and 68 percent of the height; it brightens very slightly toward the viewer so depth reads. At that depth the clearing is wide: open, level grass across about the middle 80 percent of the width, with no rocks, trees or standing stones anywhere inside it, because the camp's fire, bedrolls and heroes spread out across all of it; keep those to the outer edges and the distance. A faint worn patch of bare earth at the center, around 60 percent of the height, is a natural spot for a small campfire. At the far right edge, around 68 percent of the height, a narrow foot trail leaves the clearing and winds off toward the hills, where the party will set out. The bottom quarter of the height is plain, quiet, low-detail, slightly darker grass with no focal point, because it may sit under the lobby panels. Keep everything important inside the middle 80 percent of the width, because portrait phones crop the sides; the trail at the right edge is the one exception, and it is fine for a phone to trim it. Strong simple value structure, legible at 480px wide, calm and welcoming, never scary. No text, letters, numbers, signs with words, titles, logos, watermark or borders. No humans, no hero figures, no animals, no violence, no weapons. No purple/cyan neon palette, airbrushed 3D, photorealism or excessive fine detail. Deliver this single painting and save generated file.

paintings.plays: Stage-1 piece campfire, on the middle lane at the center of the camp. Heroes warm up at it from three stand points; it is a still painting until one does.

output.encoding: RGBA PNG, true transparency, corners fully transparent, at least 8px clear margin, lowest opaque row at y 900 (+/-12)

paintings.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Production game piece, a transparent cutout for Kids & Dragons. Warm crafted children's storybook illustration with tapered dark-brown outlines, textured soft gouache shading and upper-left light, matching the attached firepit's style; readable at 120px. One small, cozy campfire seen from a low three-quarter view: a ring of eight or nine rounded grey stones around a little stack of split logs with a friendly, modest orange and gold flame, a few sparks above it, one tin kettle resting on a stone at the back for the one funny detail. Small and homely, about knee height to a traveler, not a bonfire. Center it on a square 1024 x 1024 canvas: the whole fire, stones and flame inside the canvas with at least 8 percent transparent margin on every side, the bottom of the front stones exactly at y 900 and nothing painted below y 912. Keep the flames as one clean shape rising from the logs, with a clear edge where flame meets wood, because the flames are also cut out as a separate moving layer. Truly transparent background: no ground, no grass, no cast shadow, no glow halo baked around it, no scenery, no text.

paintings.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Moving-part cutout for the attached campfire, a layer the game flickers over it. Make it from the finished campfire painting itself, not a new generation: on the same 1024 x 1024 canvas, at exactly the same position and scale, keep only the flames and the few sparks above them; remove the stones, logs and kettle. Extend the flame's base a little way down into where the logs were, with a soft feathered lower edge, so a gentle sway or stretch never opens a gap between flame and wood. Same warm orange and gold gouache, same outlines and brush texture as the campfire. Truly transparent background, no glow halo, no smoke cloud, no text. Nothing painted below y 912.
